Underwater sound effects
Doppler shift on fast-moving sources
Ear ringing after nearby explosions
Auto music ducking during calls, pause menu and death
Distance falloff follows the game's curve
One sound plays from up to 8 speakers
Area-based sound fills rooms instead of a single point
Adjustable sound bleed from areas
Synced song playback across all players
Drift corrected via inaudible speed trim
Mid-song joiners start at the correct position
In-game editor via /surroundcreator
Place sounds, speakers, room footprints and reverb areas
Edit engine settings in-game
Export placed sounds as pasteable code
Walk around and test without losing work
